points: PalletPoseNode::on_pair is the pose-process hot path: extract_detection_candidates, select_detection (default highest_confidence, std::max_element), one depth_image_to_meters, then exactly one geometry_core::estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2. The chosen DetectionCandidate is copied out by value; the other class-matched candidates stay in that local vector and are destroyed. Their source_index values are already the Detection2DArray slots. The sent slot is passed in as instance_id and stored on PoseResult.instance_id or FailureResult.instance_id, then dropped: publish_pose writes PalletPoseStamped with no source-index fields, and publish_ok_diagnostics / publish_failure_diagnostics emit chamfer_cost_m, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, failure_reason, and the two capture stamps only. Walking the leftover candidates to publish those integers is linear in the detection count (detector postprocess caps max_detections at 10). Calling estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once per extra detection would repeat the chamfer grids below. An empty candidate list and a depth-conversion exception both return before any publish.

Measured stage-2 time is that single estimate. two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 always runs. Default free coarse is 21 yaw by 31 by 31 = 20181 (±10 deg at 1 deg, ±0.15 m at 0.01 m); free fine is 13 by 25 by 25 = 8125 (±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, ±0.012 m at 0.001 m). two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior runs unless lambda_eff <= lambda_floor 0.05. confidence is clamp((0.020 - free_cost) / 0.014, 0, 1) and lambda_eff is prior_lambda 3.0 times (1 - confidence), so the prior is skipped only when free_cost is at or below (0.020 - 0.014 * (1 - 0.05/3)) = 0.006233... m. Prior coarse is 21 by 21 by 21 = 9261 (±0.10 m at 0.01 m, same 21 yaw steps) plus another 8125 fine evaluations. The common frame is 45692 grid evaluations. Each of the four stages also calls chamfer_cost_v2 on the seed before the parallel loop, including the zero-offset cell the grid evaluates again. choose_pi_ambiguous_pose adds two full costs, anchor chamfer_cost_v2 always runs (it is before the lambda_eff branch), and a successful prior path adds one more data-only chamfer_cost_v2. OpenMP schedule(static) does not reduce that count; the critical section is once per thread after the loop.

Each grid evaluation is O(N log N). Default contour_spacing_m 0.03 builds N=182 contour points (outer 1.20 by 0.14 m is 94 samples, two 0.47 by 0.10 m pockets are 44 each), cached in cached_prototype after the first call. chamfer_cost_from_rotated assigns tls.translated = rotated (N by 2), adds (tx, ty), bilinear-samples all N distances, assign-copies all N into a std::vector, and std::sorts the whole vector even though trim_fraction 0.10 sums only ceil(0.9*N)=164. Rotation is cached per theta in thread-local ChamferTls; the translation copy and the full sort are not. sample_bilinear_into also setConstant-fills the distance buffer before the loop. The bilinear reads are Eigen column-major points(i, 0) and points(i, 1), a stride of N doubles. rotate_proto_into materializes a temporary proto * R.transpose() only when theta changes.

Before the grid, once per posed detection: rasterize_points_to_mask uses resolution_m 0.005 and padding_m 0.80. When the plane-inlier span is the nominal 1.20 m by 0.14 m face, width is ceil(2.8/0.005)+1 = 561 and height is ceil(1.7400000000000002/0.005)+1 = 350, about 196350 pixels. close_mask clones that mask, runs an elliptical MORPH_CLOSE (kernel 5), then connectedComponentsWithStats and a second full-frame mask. extract_boundary_mask erodes and builds another edge image. compute_distance_transform_v2 builds a uint8 image and calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE, then convertTo a CV_32FC1 distance image. That OpenCV imgproc work is the large non-search dependency inside stage 2 and is rebuilt every frame; the prototype cache does not reuse the distance image. It is still smaller than the 45692-evaluation grid.

sample_face_points scans every depth pixel, O(Hd*Wd). Vendored camera.yaml is depth 640 by 480 and RGB 1920 by 1080, so each posed detection walks 307200 pixels: a K_inv ray, an SE3 into RGB, a pinhole project, and a lookup in the full RGB mask. build_bbox_mask first zero-fills that 1920 by 1080 CV_8UC1 and erodes the whole image erode_px 2 times, even though only the bbox rectangle is set. Accepted points go into per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> buckets that together reserve Hd*Wd/4 (about 1.8 MB) regardless of bbox size, then are copied again, one row at a time, into an N by 3 Eigen::MatrixXd.

ransac_plane_fit runs up to ransac_iters 100 and stops early only at inlier ratio 0.85. Every iteration allocates a residual ArrayXd and a bool mask over all face points; the winning inliers are copied into a fresh matrix for Eigen::JacobiSVD. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 then calls plane_inlier_mask, which allocates those arrays again, and copies the inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates both a relative N by 3 matrix and an N by 2 result. estimate_pca_long_axis allocates another centred copy of the 2D inliers. Those passes are linear in the face-point count and sit under the chamfer grid. depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame into a new CV_32FC1 once per synced pair, before the single estimate, so it does not multiply with extra detections.

Stage 1 is a separate process and is not where the unused source indexes are published. rtdetr_detector_node defaults to backend mock, which skips inference copies. full_pipeline.launch.py loads detector.yaml with backend tensorrt and input_size 640. On that path image_to_rgb copies msg.data via bytes() (about 6.2 MB for 1920 by 1080 rgb8) and ascontiguousarray, preprocess resizes to 640 by 640 and builds a float32 CHW array (1 by 3 by 640 by 640, about 4.9 MB), and TensorRTBackend.infer astype-copies both inputs, np.copyto into pagelocked host memory, memcpy HtoD, then .copy() of labels, boxes, and scores after DtoH. postprocess is a score threshold and an argsort capped at max_detections 10, with no NMS. tensorrt plus pycuda dominate stage 1; the pose process still pays the chamfer grids after message_filters delivers the pair.

geometry_core links Eigen3 dynamic matrices, OpenCV core and imgproc, and OpenMP, compiled -O3. yaml-cpp loads the camera model only in the node constructor, not per frame. message_filters ApproximateTime (queue 10, slop 0.1 s) only gates the pair. Publishing an int32 sent index and a short int32[] of deferred slots on PalletPoseStamped, or the same two lists as KeyValue strings on the existing failure DiagnosticStatus, is outside the 45692-evaluation loop.
